## Gap Analysis

1. Count the TOTAL number of unique customer dialogs in the dataset
2. Count how many of those contain payment/billing problems
3. Calculate if this equals 10%

From my search, I found many payment/billing issue dialogs, but I haven't exhaustively reviewed all 1197 rows to get an accurate count. Multiple dialogs could involve the same customer, and one customer could have multiple unrelated issues. This makes calculating "10% of customers" difficult without clarification on what constitutes a unique customer.

## Analysis

From the first 100 rows of my search results (which heavily weighted payment/billing keywords), I identified at least **30+ dialogs clearly involving payment or billing issues**.
